title: L10N-aware reranker model selection and smoke regression framework
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Select and validate cross-encoder reranker variants with explicit per-locale quality targets, latency/SLO constraints, and an automated smoke-regression harness that flags semantic and latency regressions before rollout.
goals: Identify 2-3 candidate cross-encoder variants (quantized/distilled/multilingual) that meet per-language MRR/NDCG baselines
Ensure P95 inference latency for rerank endpoint <= 160ms for 1-16 candidate lists at 95th percentile traffic mix
Provide an automated regression suite covering semantic regressions, output-stability, and cost-per-query projections
Ship canary rollout tooling that supports per-region and per-language weightings with automatic rollback on regression signals
approach: Inventory current rerank pipeline: bi-encoder candidate generator + cross-encoder ranker. Capture tokenization, candidate lengths, and per-locale distributions from production telemetry.
Shortlist model variants: full-precision multilingual cross-encoder, distilled multilingual (smaller heads), int8 quantized variants, and locale-specific fine-tuned checkpoints where available.
Offline evaluation: run each variant on stratified eval sets (en, es, fr, de, zh, ja, pt, and low-resource locales) to compute MRR@10, NDCG@10, precision@1, and confidence calibration metrics.

Latency profiling: benchmark GPU and CPU variants with realistic batch sizes, varying candidate list lengths (5, 10, 20), and mixed-locale request mixes to produce P50/P95/P99 latency curves and GPU memory footprints.

Regression harness: build smoke checks that run on PR and nightly pipelines comparing candidate to baseline on holdout sets and sampled production requests (anonymized). Include semantic-similarity delta thresholds and latency/cost thresholds that trigger failures.

Canary rollout: integrate with Console rollouts to route a fraction of traffic to candidate models by locale and region. Implement alerting and automatic rollback rules based on combined signal (semantic regression + latency SLO breach + error rate increase).
rollout_plan: T0: Offline evaluation and profiling (2 weeks). Deliver model scoring table and resource estimates.
T1: Build regression harness and baseline snapshots (1 week). Configure thresholds per-locale.
T2: Internal canary (5% traffic split) for non-critical customers, 48h observation window.
T3: Expand canary to 20% for 7 days while monitoring signals. If stable, promote to 50% and run longer-term quality checks.
T4: Full rollout with rollout notes, migration guide for customers, and post-rollout A/B analysis.
acceptance_criteria: At least one candidate variant meets or improves baseline MRR@10 across en/es/fr/de with no more than 2% absolute degradation in any supported language
P95 latency for common candidate-list sizes (10 items) is <= 160ms on Dedicated GPU pools or <= 420ms on CPU fallbacks
Regression harness runs on every model PR and nightly; any semantic delta > 1.5% absolute drop in MRR triggers a failed CI status
Canary automation successfully rolls back on >1.5% semantic drop OR P95 latency regressions >25% over baseline OR error-rate increase >0.5%
benchmarks: Baseline: current production reranker (multilingual-large-x) — MRR@10: 0.412 (en), 0.365 (es), 0.348 (fr); P95 latency: 140ms (GPU pool)
Candidate A: distilled-multi-small — MRR@10 delta: -0.015 (en), -0.012 (es); P95 latency: 95ms; memory -35%
Candidate B: quantized-int8-multi — MRR@10 delta: -0.008 (en), -0.004 (es); P95 latency: 110ms; cost estimate -28%
Candidate C: locale-finetuned (en/es) — MRR@10 delta: +0.009 (en), +0.012 (es); P95 latency: +22ms; requires per-locale checkpoints and additional storage
regression_harness: Dataset composition: holdout sets per language (min 10k pairs), synthetic perturbation sets (typos, code-switching), and 2k anonymized sampled production candidate lists per locale.
Checks: semantic delta (MRR, NDCG), output stability (top-1 swap rate), hallucination spike checks (domain-specific QA tests), latency P95/P99 drift, and per-request token consumption.
Thresholds: semantic delta fail >= 1.5% absolute MRR drop OR top-1 swap rate > 7% without quality justification; latency fail if P95 increases >25% relative or exceeds target SLO.
CI integration: run lightweight smoke tests in PRs (small sample) and full harness nightly; results recorded in Console regression dashboard with historical diffs and links to failing cases.
Escalation: failing nightly run auto-opens ENG ticket with failing examples, attaches profiler traces, and annotates candidate rollout status.
data_and_evals: Collect per-locale telemetry: candidate lengths, query embedding norms, and tokenization mismatch rates. Use these signals to weight eval sampling.
Create domain slices: search, support KB, product listings, and multilingual chat transcripts. Ensure representation for rare-locale intents.
Establish golden examples per locale (500 queries) for manual review during canary windows.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: distilled/quantized variants may break rare-case semantics — Mitigation: increase sampling of low-resource/localized examples and keep fallback to baseline model for flagged queries.
Risk: per-locale checkpoints increase storage and management overhead — Mitigation: start with hybrid approach (multilingual base + small locale adapters) and measure runtime memory impact.
Risk: Canary traffic not representative of real world — Mitigation: weight canary routing by locale and query length buckets to match production distribution.
